title: BiblePassageReference
description: A successfully normalized reference to exactly one contiguous inclusive passage within one Biblical book. Structural validation does not establish Bible-domain validity.

verse_start.description: Inclusive starting verse. Both verse endpoints must be integers or both null; null means complete chapter(s), never an unknown or inferred verse.

verse_end.description: Inclusive ending verse in chapter_end; equal to verse_start for a single verse. Null only when verse_start is also null.

chapter_start.description: Inclusive starting chapter; repeated as chapter_end for a single chapter.

original_text.description: The supplied reference preserved exactly, including whitespace, punctuation, and Unicode characters.

language.description: Language of the original reference when known.

canon_profile.description: Canon and numbering convention. For P0 v0.1, the Protestant 66-book canon and numbering convention used by the P0 reference data. A separate numbering profile may be added in a future contract revision.
